long_biography.plain_text:
At Rizzani de Eccher's Qatar operation, Mauro Gestri held regional responsibility before moving to Tedeschia Construction Enterprises. There he oversaw work around Al Udeid Air Base—runways, aprons, roads, earthworks and drainage. He later became a director of major Italian builder ICM.

A different chapter opened in 2022 when Gestri bought all shares in Gualdo del Re at Suvereto. Rather than replacing the established winemaker, he backed Barbara Tamburini while funding new plantings, modernised production buildings and a larger guest offering. That transition returned part of his activity to Tuscany after years abroad and complements his role as owner-helmsman of an international racing team.
